notes.account: The page continues a condition that X be locally homotopically trivial, then says its Artin–Mazur simplicial pro-set is essentially constant in the ordinary homotopy category and so gives an ordinary homotopy type. It denies that situation for the étale topos of a scheme, calls for a pro-n-groupoid as fundamental n-groupoid, and an ind n-category for the category denoted by the rounded E_n. It links the ind structure to local triviality under increasingly fine coverings. After the three-rule separator it acknowledges resistance to stripping a topos down to its homotopy type and starts an unfinished statement of conviction.
notes.author_qualification_and_uncertainty: The continuation begins exactly “ceci de supposer que X est” and later says “doit être conçu comme un”. The closing wording is “Bien plus, je suis persuadé qu’en”, an unfinished assertion of conviction. No explicit proof or question is present on this sheet. No earlier or following page has been consulted.

The mathematics motivated checking the negative pas and the alleged n underline, but neither grammar nor mathematical expectation was used to supply an accent or letter. notes.punctuation_and_marks: The point-like blob immediately after the lower-right X stroke at L18 is aligned with that stroke and is read as its interrupted terminal ink, not an extra full stop before the parenthesis. The definite sentence point is after the parenthesis. The small mark above/left of Je is carried with the initial handwritten J. The separate right-edge stroke and the tiny lower-right point are reproduced without assigning them a word, insertion instruction, or sentence-ending function.
